label: REAL HISTORICAL DATA
method: Weekly starts from the window-start ECR rank (rank→rate curve fitted on earlier seasons) blended with points since the window start (kInfo pseudo-games). Value = Σ over started weeks (points − mean of the 3 best non-starters that week). Predictions = availability(tier) × team games × E[max(0, rate − r)], all fitted on earlier seasons. Ratios are relative to ranks 1–12 (values are rescaled to the top assets).

fit.label: expected surplus, m × model σ, m fitted on earlier seasons

rate.label: expected surplus, rate-only σ (weekly noise removed)

v22_smooth.label: E11: 0.4σ, availability = smooth non-increasing curve by rank

v22_pos.label: E11: 0.4σ, availability = one share per position

v22_none.label: E11: 0.4σ, no availability (every team game, as healthy projections)

v22_rel.label: E11: 0.4σ, within-position availability shape (smooth curve ÷ position starter share)

v22_reltier.label: E11: 0.4σ, within-position shape from the 5-tier table

v22_relcap.label: E11: 0.4σ, within-position shape, held flat beyond 2× 12-team starters (backups: role, not injury)
